'''Maintenance''' is a card icon. A card with the maintenance icon states a maintenance cost in its game text, paid at the end of its owner's turn (for example ''End of your turn: Use 2 Force to maintain OR Lose 1 Force to place in Used Pile OR Place out of play'' on [[Thok & Thug]]).
